name: us023-second-event-advances
description: 023, Phase 5, US3 (contract run-state-v2.md §6): two runs, same workdir and mock, files byte-identical between them. Run 1 (under after_plan) resolves and moves COMP-2 to "In Progress", recording state with hook_event="after_plan". Before run 2, the recorded document's hook_event is patched to "after_specify" -- simulating what a genuinely earlier, different event's recording looks like from run_state_matches' own point of view (the mechanism run-state-v2.md §2 gates on) -- so run 2 (still under after_plan, files untouched) is proven NOT short-circuited: it re-reads recognition (a non-empty call log) rather than trusting the stale document, even though the ticket itself needs no further move (already at its declared step).

content.text: We need to prove a declared mapping moves a recognised story to its agreed step.
As a user, I want the first capability.
